title: CORD: Cohort-Oriented Roadmap Decision framework (cost + latency thresholds)
creator: Priya Patel
description: Problem: Our existing RICE-heavy prioritization surfaces high-impact items but misses workload heterogeneity: features that matter to high-value cohorts with tight latency budgets are often underprioritized when averaged across all traffic. Goal: Define a decision framework that blends RICE-style scoring with cohort-weighted thresholds and hard cost/latency gates so roadmap assignments reflect both aggregate impact and operational constraints. Scope: PM-led prioritization rubric, sample scoring tooling (spreadsheet + script), example scoring for 6 candidate initiatives, and integration guidance for quarterly planning and OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: A documented CORD rubric with scoring and gating rules stored in Confluence
A sample worksheet and script that computes cohort-weighted scores for candidate initiatives
Runbook showing how to interpret scores for roadmap trade-offs and an example allocation for Q2 2026
Presentation to GTM/Eng with feedback loop and sign-off by product leadership
sample_calculation: Overview: Score = CohortWeight * ImpactScore * ReachFactor / (1 + CostAdj + LatencyPenalty). Where: CohortWeight = fraction of ARR or MRR associated with the cohort; ImpactScore = 1..10 (value to cohort); ReachFactor = fraction of active users in that cohort affected; CostAdj = normalized monthly token cost / baselineCost; LatencyPenalty = if expected p95 increase > threshold then add 0.5 per 50ms. Example: For high-value cohort (CohortWeight=0.25), ImpactScore=8, Reach=0.4, CostAdj=0.6, LatencyPenalty=0.5 -> Score = 0.25*8*0.4/(1+0.6+0.5)=0.8/2.1=0.381. Decision thresholds: >0.6 green, 0.35-0.6 amber, <0.35 red. Green initiatives recommended for canary next cycle, amber = rework or scope-down, red = deprioritize or prototype only.
decisions: Adopt cohort-weighting tied to revenue and SLA sensitivity rather than pure user counts
Introduce hard latency gates: any initiative that increases p95 beyond cohort SLA by >50ms requires approval from SRE and a mitigation plan
Normalize token cost as CostAdj by dividing projected incremental cost by median initiative cost for the cycle
Use three-tier output (green/amber/red) instead of raw rank for clearer roadmap signals
